title: Unit-noise influences and first-level regularity
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f$ be a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, and suppose $0\leq\varepsilon$. The stable influences of $f$ at noise parameter $1$ are all at most $\varepsilon$ if and only if every nonempty subset $S$ of coordinates with $|S|\leq1$ has Fourier coefficient of absolute value at most $\sqrt{\varepsilon}$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is real-valued on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
